programs.title: Inspector Morse
programs.desc: Inspector Morse uncovers a web of intrigue, blackmail and hidden passion in a local insurance office when he investigates the death of a young secretary. Sylvia Kane's body is found in a carpark after she had hitched a lift to the pub to meet her boyfriend.  The mystery deepens when Morse finds a coded message in Sylvia's bag addressed to her boss, Jennifer. The car that Sylvia got a lift in is traced to the wife of an eminent professor. There's more intrigue when Morse discovers the message from Sylvia's bag was not intended for Jennifer and a sum of money from the envelope had been taken.
